zones.title: Confirm
zones.body: The picked slot must be one FindSlots offered in this call. State CONFIRM and the slotId go on the session; BookingGate books the same slotId in the next turn.

panels.title: AR-56 ConfirmSlot
panels.body: The CONFIRM step AR-02 performs in the demo, as a tool: the model calls it with the slot the caller picked, reads back what it returns, and books only after the yes. A slot not offered in this call is refused.
